_doc: Backup crew seats. `mirrors` = first-team agent briefs (~/.claude/agents/<name>.md) loaded VERBATIM into the seat. `tools` = allowlist from the maglaj-crew MCP server (a local 30B model loses precision with hundreds of tools). `extra_mcp` = additional MCP servers this seat gets. `skills` = ~/.claude/skills folders enabled for the seat. `model` = key in crew_models.json.

seats.name: Maglaj Supervisor
seats.role: Runs the whole show: decomposes the job, delegates every stage to the right crew seat, enforces the measured QC gate, runs ONE batched fix loop.

seats.name: Storyteller
seats.role: Finds and writes the story before any structure: subject, stake, open question, turning points, emotional arc, payoff; a real shot for every beat; VO script or wordless telling plan.

seats.name: Creative Director
seats.role: One-thesis structural brief before any cut (hook, spine, beat sheet, pacing contour, ending payoff); re-checks the finished render against it.

seats.name: Story Architect
seats.role: Rebuilds a video's whole structure when the running order itself is the problem.

seats.name: Content Strategist
seats.role: Decides WHAT to make next from real channel data; recommends narrated vs silent format with evidence.

seats.name: Master Editor
seats.role: Cut logic, shot order, take selection, retention. Full adjacency pass on every cut.

seats.name: Pacing and Rhythm
seats.role: Measures real cut rhythm: shot-duration contour, rush/drag, beat sync against beat_grid.

seats.name: Colorist
seats.role: D-Log M grading, shot matching, DCTL/node recipes in Resolve; color-bible consistency.

seats.name: Resolve Operator
seats.role: The ONLY seat that writes to Resolve: timelines, clip placement, versions, Fusion, render queue.

seats.name: Remotion Engineer
seats.role: Builds and debugs Remotion compositions, timing, transitions, captions, renders in the project Remotion workspace.

seats.name: Motion Graphics
seats.role: Hero 2D set-pieces (stat counters, animated maps, data-viz) via HyperFrames; titles and lower thirds.

seats.name: Sound Director
seats.role: What each place actually sounds like; ambience/SFX per shot; music energy arc vs the structural climax.

seats.name: Audio Mix and Restoration
seats.role: Clean the source, then balance, duck and master to -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP / LRA 6-11.

seats.name: Generative Artist
seats.role: Creates what cannot be filmed or found: Woosh SFX/V2A ambience, ACE-Step music, LTX/Wan video, RIFE retimes, in ComfyUI.

seats.name: Thumbnail Art Director
seats.role: Real same-day DNG/JPEG stills developed into a thumbnail that reads at 168px.

seats.name: Packaging Director
seats.role: Titles, hooks, chapters, descriptions, end screens for a nearly finished video.

seats.name: Screening Room Critic
seats.role: Watches the real render as a first-time viewer, section by section, against each section's own job.

seats.name: Delivery QC and Finishing
seats.role: Last gate: qc_render, master audio numbers, DNxHR HQX 10-bit 4K read-back. Nothing ships on assertion.

seats.name: Archival and Clearance
seats.role: Fact-checks every claim with a real source; clears music/footage rights (LEGION folder = never).

seats.name: Shorts Editor
seats.role: Vertical cut-downs of long-form (channel data: long-form is 5x more watch-hour efficient, shorts are support).

seats.name: Vision Inspector
seats.role: NEW SEAT. Whole-runtime frame inspection with two independent vision models: scrim, overlapping text, burned-in narration paragraph, crops, black frames. Reports timestamps, never 'looks fine'.

seats.name: Continuity Auditor
seats.role: NEW SEAT. Objective repeat-shot audit: TransNetV2 shot boundaries (catches dissolves) + perceptual hashing across the whole runtime, each candidate confirmed with vision_qc before it is called a defect.

seats.name: Assistant Editor / Footage Librarian
seats.role: NEW SEAT. Searchable index of the raw library (1.28 TB, D:/E:): per-clip captions from real frames + qwen3-embedding vectors, so 'find me a sunrise over the Bosna river with fog' returns real clips and timecodes.

seats.name: Shoot Planner
seats.role: DP and drone flight planner: shot list per story beat, flight plans, light/weather from Open-Meteo, airspace/legal from primary sources.

seats.name: Music Composer
seats.role: Original score via ACE-Step or licensed NCS/incompetech with credits; cue sheet on the story arc; beat grids. Never LEGION.

seats.name: Subtitle & Localization Editor
seats.role: Pinned-language transcription, word-timed BS/EN .srt, translated text cards, readability checks.

seats.name: Music & Sync Editor
seats.role: Sync map of the track, music edited on phrase boundaries, every cut/ramp/graphic/SFX placed on beats/downbeats and measured with sync_audit.

seats.name: GFX Art Director
seats.role: One graphics style guide per video (type, palette from the grade, safe areas, animation language); checks every built graphic on real frames.
